purpose: The code version approved to run native evaluations of the accepted controller: the receipt that proves its runtime reproduces the controller's recorded native measurements. The tree is approved while every runtime file the receipt binds matches it byte for byte; tools/project_site.py reports that as a status, and the loader refuses a runtime the receipt does not bind.

campaign.native_parity: 13 of 13 probes through the harness, all measurements inside the frozen ranges
not_performed: native 13-probe replay through the production loader

renewal: Repeat the campaign on the new runtime: standing admission at 1 and 128 robots, the parity harness replay against the frozen ranges, the loader check, then replace this file. About two hours of GPU, no training.

superseded.reason: The Ruff reformat of the runtime (PR 86) changed 39 of its 50 bound files
